title: A Semester for the Recipe
author: Noor Fairweather
blurb: Yara Marchetti, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
